sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', o.date) < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 25

SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE (2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN '12-01' < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 25
